examples.text: You can organize（organise的美式拼写organize） meetings on a regular basis, receive feedback from your employees and never speak in anger to them.
examples.translation: 你可以定期组织会议，听取员工反馈，而且绝不对他们发火。
examples.speechText: You can organize meetings on a regular basis, receive feedback from your employees and never speak in anger to them.

examples.text: Allow things to settle with time.
examples.translation: 让事情随着时间慢慢平息下来。
examples.speechText: Allow things to settle with time.

examples.text: Honest communication matters more than perfection.
examples.translation: 坦诚沟通比事事完美更重要。
examples.speechText: Honest communication matters more than perfection.

examples.text: Focusing on our health is particularly crucial.
examples.translation: 关注我们的健康尤为重要。
examples.speechText: Focusing on our health is particularly crucial.

examples.text: Within a few days she was 'trying out' for me.
examples.translation: 没过几天，她就开始在我手下试工了。
examples.speechText: Within a few days she was 'trying out' for me.

examples.text: Work runs late, energy drops, or a headache starts（start的第三人称单数形式）.
examples.translation: 工作拖到很晚、精力下降，或者开始头疼。
examples.speechText: Work runs late, energy drops, or a headache starts.

examples.text: No one likes getting a speeding（speed的-ing形式） ticket.
examples.translation: 没有人喜欢收到超速罚单。
examples.speechText: No one likes getting a speeding ticket.

examples.text: Some reports（report的复数形式） show that you can burn as many as 500 calories in only 30 minutes of the activity.
examples.translation: 有报告表明，只进行这项活动三十分钟，就能消耗多达500大卡的热量。
examples.speechText: Some reports show that you can burn as many as 500 calories in only 30 minutes of the activity.

examples.text: Losers tended（tend的过去式） to go from rock to paper to scissors.
examples.translation: 失败者倾向于按石头、布、剪刀的顺序更换手势。
examples.speechText: Losers tended to go from rock to paper to scissors.

examples.text: Some news spread quickly, and the result is fake（虚假的） news.
examples.translation: 有些消息传播得很快，而结果却是假新闻。
examples.speechText: Some news spread quickly, and the result is fake news.

examples.text: Baldwin is president of the World Rock Paper Scissors Association.
examples.translation: Baldwin是世界石头剪刀布协会主席。
examples.speechText: Baldwin is president of the World Rock Paper Scissors Association.

examples.text: I would always recommend buying a good quality car rather than a cheap one.
examples.translation: 我总是建议买质量好的车，而不是便宜的车。
examples.speechText: I would always recommend buying a good quality car rather than a cheap one.

examples.text: Work runs（run的第三人称单数形式） late, energy drops, or a headache starts.
examples.translation: 工作持续到很晚、精力下降，或者开始头疼。
examples.speechText: Work runs late, energy drops, or a headache starts.

examples.text: Parents are advised to learn about the Internet along with their children.
examples.translation: 家长被建议和孩子一起了解互联网。
examples.speechText: Parents are advised to learn about the Internet along with their children.

examples.text: Thousands of years ago, humans collected nuts and fruits.
examples.translation: 几千年前，人类采集坚果和水果。
examples.speechText: Thousands of years ago, humans collected nuts and fruits.
